newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London end mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London end mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mixed on Friday in a quiet trading day with profit-taking seen in some of the blue-chip exporters, traders said.
"Basically it was a quiet day with continued interest seen in some of the blue-chip exporters which have been doing well over the last week," one trader said.
"Issues that have reached their year-highs were less in demand and we were starting to see some profit-taking there."

Dealers said Marubeni Corp looked weak in London after the company said it would post an appraisal loss of around 28 billion yen on its securities holdings in the year to March 31 due to sluggish stock prices.
Marubeni shares ended two yen lower on the day at 479 yen in Tokyo.
Steel and heavy industry stocks also aroused some interest, traders said.
Unaffected by the U.S. employment report, the Nikkei 50 share index was down 0.56 point to 1,449.95 in London.
In Tokyo on Friday, the Nikkei 225-share index slipped 268.72 points, or 1.48 percent, to close at 17,860.59, depressed by continuing weakness in the brokerage and construction sectors, brokers said.
